brief:
Settlers are continuing construction work to expand an agricultural outpost they established near the Al-Mhattash Bedouin community, which sits adjacent to Al-Khan Al-Ahmar in occupied territory east of Jerusalem, Shehab Wire reported. The expansion represents the latest in a series of settlement activities affecting the area and its Palestinian residents.

The outpost's growth comes amid longstanding tensions over Israeli settlement expansion in the occupied West Bank. Al-Khan Al-Ahmar and surrounding Bedouin communities have faced repeated pressure from settlement activity and Israeli military operations. International observers and Palestinian rights groups have documented the expansion as part of a broader pattern of settlement consolidation in areas east of Jerusalem.
